item.title: Are You Being Nice to the Bots?
item.description: What’s the harm in being nice to a chatbot? With tech companies warning of potential future A.I. sentience, Spencer Klavan, an associate editor for the Claremont Review of Books, argues that treating chatbots like humans puts us on a slippery slope of redefining moral personhood. “We won’t really be elevating the moral status of A.I.,” he argues. All we’ll be doing is reducing living human beings “to the equivalent of a box of equations.”
